definitions.explanation: The act of throwing away or abandoning something, especially waste or unwanted items, often illegally. Most commonly used in the context of illegal dumping of garbage or hazardous materials.

examples.japanese: ⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{不法投棄|ふほうとうき}→不法投棄：18933_fuhoutouki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{犯罪|はんざい}→犯罪：03569_hanzai⟧だ。
examples.english: Illegal dumping of garbage is a crime.

examples.japanese: ⟦{産業廃棄物|さんぎょうはいきぶつ}→産業廃棄物：19064_sangyouhaikibutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{不法投棄|ふほうとうき}→不法投棄：18933_fuhoutouki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧になっている。
examples.english: Illegal dumping of industrial waste has become a problem.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海洋|かいよう}→海洋：00143_kaiyou⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{廃棄物|はいきぶつ}→廃棄物：04634_haikibutsu⟧{投棄|とうき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{国際条約|こくさいじょうやく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{厳|きび}しく→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦{規制|きせい}→規制：02598_kisei⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Dumping waste into the ocean is strictly regulated by international treaties.

notes:
Composed of {投|とう} (throw) + {棄|き} (discard/abandon). Almost always used in a negative context — illegal, irresponsible, or environmentally harmful disposal of waste.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{不法投棄|ふほうとうき}→不法投棄：18933_fuhoutouki⟧: illegal dumping (the most common usage)
- ⟦{廃棄物|はいきぶつ}→廃棄物：04634_haikibutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{投棄|とうき}: dumping of waste
- {海洋投棄|かいようとうき}: ocean dumping
- {投棄|とうき}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to dump; to dispose of illegally
- {投棄|とうき}⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧: dumping prohibited

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{廃棄|はいき}→廃棄：12482_haiki⟧: disposal, scrapping — more neutral; refers to proper disposal or scrapping of items
- ⟦{処分|しょぶん}→処分：05520_shobun⟧: disposal, disposition — broader and more neutral; includes both proper and improper disposal
- ⟦{放棄|ほうき}→放棄：12825_houki⟧: abandonment, renunciation — giving up rights or claims; less about physical dumping

USAGE:
⟦{不法投棄|ふほうとうき}→不法投棄：18933_fuhoutouki⟧ (illegal dumping) is a major environmental concern in Japan. Signs reading {投棄|とうき}⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧ (no dumping) are common in rural areas and along roadsides. Penalties for illegal dumping can include imprisonment and fines.
